name: PolyCup
author: Kiki
description: Simple live Cups for 2–8 racers: one track pick each, finalist scoring, smooth POV spectating, PB and record panels.
changelog: Set the finalist target to 140 points; an outright win in a later round still wins the Cup.
Use each track WR to schedule approximately four minutes of racing, rounded to whole races and fixed at Cup start.
Use four rounds when a WR is missing or unavailable; preserve the schedule across repeats, saves, reconnects and undo.
